champion.name: Industry Diffusion + Weekly Low-MAX
champion.breadth: exact frozen Top-10 Industry Diffusion allocation followed by within-industry prior-20-session MAX ascending
champion.holding: exact frozen next-open entry and 20-session cohort due-open exit with QD-010 pre-effective exits and legal-fill delays

track_a_lifecycle.checkpoint_value: actual lot value at checkpoint-session open after entry, including visible action cash and hypothetical 20-bps sell cost; a previously forced-exited lot carries its realized payoff
track_a_lifecycle.day_20: actual frozen legal exit payoff, including forced exits and any due-open legal-fill delay
track_a_lifecycle.control: no new control; report only the already-authoritative Cycle-011 h20 Low-MAX-minus-baseline candidate excess

classification.CHRONOLOGICALLY_UNSTABLE: d20 mean payoff signs differ across blocks
classification.LATE_DECAY_OR_GIVEBACK: d20 is at least 25 bps below d10 in full, early, and late
classification.EARLY_CONCENTRATED: d5 captures at least 75% of positive d20 mean in full, early, and late
classification.FULL_HORIZON_PERSISTENT: d20 minus d10 is at least 25 bps in full, early, and late
classification.MID_HORIZON_PERSISTENT: otherwise d10 minus d5 is at least 25 bps and d20 minus d10 exceeds minus 25 bps in full, early, and late

track_b_rank.rank_source: exact frozen emitted champion signal_rank; no reranking or new score

classification.BREADTH_ECONOMICALLY_SUPPORTED: all bucket mean payoffs are positive full and ranks 6-10 are positive in both blocks
classification.LOWER_RANKS_WEAK_BUT_POSITIVE: ranks 6-10 are positive full but nonpositive in at least one block
classification.LOWER_RANKS_DILUTIVE: ranks 6-10 are nonpositive full and in both blocks

track_c_opportunity.primary_richness: count of quality-valid eligible stocks in the entry-date industries and exact counts selected by frozen Industry Diffusion
secondary_descriptors: diffusion-score margin between frozen ranks 10 and 11
track_c_opportunity.buckets: stable equal-count thirds after sorting decision dates by primary richness then decision date; full-sample ex-ante covariates only, no outcomes

track_d_concentration.contribution: actual realized trade proceeds minus invested cost; sums exactly to final NAV minus initial capital
track_d_concentration.fragility: STRUCTURALLY_FRAGILE_DEVELOPMENT_ALPHA only if removing the largest industry or largest year makes residual total net PnL nonpositive
track_d_concentration.concentrated: CONCENTRATED_BUT_ECONOMICALLY_MEANINGFUL if top-5 industries, top-10 dates, or top-20 securities exceed 60% of net PnL while leave-one-out remains positive

track_e_persistence.state: the original selected industry is represented in the contemporaneous top-10 eligible stocks ranked by the exact frozen diffusion_score descending then symbol at the completed checkpoint date
track_e_persistence.early_fade: first nonpersistent checkpoint is day 5 or day 10
track_e_persistence.subsequent_payoff: actual final net payoff minus checkpoint cumulative net payoff; no hypothetical exit is executed

prohibited: Top-N, horizon, weekly clock, industry definition, Low-MAX, weighting, allocation, exit, cost, or universe change
Top-5/8/12/15 replay or h10/h15/h25 strategy replay
OOS, independent-validation, live, or production claim
